svg.title: SAGEAgent: cost-aware sequential modality acquisition
svg.desc: (a) Existing approaches: static multimodal fusion gives the same workup to every patient, RL acquisition policies are black boxes, and LLM-based acquisition treats tests as independent with no clinical order. (b) SAGEAgent follows the clinical order demographics, radiology, pathology, genomics. Patient A: after radiology the uncertainty is low (0.05), the learned rule and 3 of 3 similar cases say stop, so the agent predicts and skips pathology and genomics: burden 0.17, 83 percent saved. Patient B: uncertainty is high (0.67), so the agent acquires pathology; uncertainty is still moderate (0.27), so it acquires genomics: full workup, burden 1.00.
